title: landing page loads with hero section and navigation
description: Navigate to the landing page and verify hero section and navigation render correctly.
steps: Navigate to /site
Verify the page title or heading contains agency management or platform text
Verify the navigation bar is visible with links for Pricing, About, Contact
Verify a Get Started or call-to-action button is present in the hero section

title: landing page pricing section displays plans
description: Verify the pricing section shows plan cards with Rs currency.
steps: Navigate to /site
Scroll to the pricing section or navigate to /site#pricing
Verify at least two pricing plan cards are visible
Verify price amounts contain Rs (Nepali Rupees format)
Verify each plan card has a list of features

title: landing page about section renders with features
description: Verify the about section displays feature descriptions with icons.
steps: Navigate to /site#about
Verify the About section heading is visible
Verify feature items are displayed with descriptive text
Verify SVG icons are present next to feature descriptions

title: contact form submission with valid data
description: Fill and submit the contact form with valid data.
steps: Navigate to /site#contact
Fill in the Name field with 'Test User'
Fill in the Email field with 'test@example.com'
Fill in the Subject field with 'Test Subject'
Fill in the Message field with 'This is a test message from TestSprite'
Click the Submit or Send button
Verify a success toast notification or message appears

title: contact form validation rejects empty fields
description: Verify the contact form shows validation errors for empty required fields.
steps: Navigate to /site#contact
Click the Submit or Send button without filling any fields
Verify the form does not submit or shows validation error feedback

title: footer renders with link columns and copyright
description: Verify the footer section displays correctly.
steps: Navigate to /site
Scroll to the bottom of the page to the footer section
Verify Product, Resources, and Company link columns are visible
Verify the copyright text includes 2026 or the current year
Verify social media icon links are present

title: sign in page renders login form
description: Navigate to the sign-in page and verify the login form is present.
steps: Navigate to /agency/auth/sign-in
Verify email input field is present
Verify password input field is present
Verify a sign in or login button is present

title: navigation anchor links scroll to sections
description: Verify clicking navigation links scrolls to the correct page sections.
steps: Navigate to /site
Click the Pricing link in the navigation bar
Verify the pricing section is now visible in the viewport
Click the About link in the navigation bar
Verify the about section is now visible in the viewport
Click the Contact link in the navigation bar
Verify the contact section is now visible in the viewport

title: testimonials section displays reviews
description: Verify the testimonials section shows customer review cards.
steps: Navigate to /site
Scroll to the testimonials section
Verify at least one testimonial card is visible
Verify each card shows a name, role or title, and review text

title: landing page icons render as SVGs in all sections
description: Verify Lucide React icons render correctly across all landing page sections.
steps: Navigate to /site
Verify SVG elements are present in the hero badge area
Scroll to the pricing section and verify SVG check icons in feature lists
Scroll to the about section and verify SVG icons next to feature items
Scroll to the contact section and verify form label icons

title: landing page is responsive on mobile viewport
description: Verify the landing page works on a mobile viewport.
steps: Set viewport to 375px width (mobile)
Navigate to /site
Verify the page content is visible and not horizontally scrolling
Verify navigation adapts to mobile layout (hamburger menu or stacked)
